newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: MCCARTHY FINANCIAL SERVICES APPOINTS NEW MD.
newsitem.headline: MCCARTHY FINANCIAL SERVICES APPOINTS NEW MD.

text.p: McCarthy Group Ltd unit McCarthy Financial Services said on Thursday it has appointed Colin Franks as its new managing director.
Franks is former managing director of African Bank.
The company said in a statement he will be joined by Peter Gover and Grant Coppin, both formerly of NBS .
McCarthy Financial Services will be based in Durban and will initially take on motor-related financial services before developing general asset-based financing with a treasury operation.
The company has lodged a banking licence application with the Registrar of Banks which it expects to be approved shortly.
On approval, the company will change its name to McCarthy Bank Ltd.
